messages:
sam: Quick check — I want to enable `audit_mode_v2` in staging as a small canary (10% internal) to validate retention glue + KMS/HSM fallback paths before we do any prod rollouts. Who can do a preflight review?

maya: +1. What exactly does `audit_mode_v2` flip? is it just logging or retention behavior as well?

sam: It does three things: 1) turns on structured PII audit logs (masked by default), 2) exercises the retention_grace override path, and 3) routes key ops through the HSM proxy if the key policy requires it. We want to confirm there are no silent fallback gaps.

jonathan: I can take a look. Need the exact flag toggle and the environment scope. Do we have a JSON snippet for the FF change?

sam: Yup — planning to use FlagService API. Patch I intend to run:
```
PATCH /flags/audit_mode_v2
{
  "environments": {
    "staging": { "percentage": 10, "audiences": ["internal-alpha"] }
  },
  "meta": { "reason": "preflight retention/KMS/HSM paths" }
}
```

maya: Nice. Couple of guardrails please: 1) must log any KMS->HSM fallback events to security audit channel, 2) must not auto-flush retention counters, 3) enable kill-switch for immediate rollback.

alice: Adding notes from compliance: ensure the masked PII pattern is the same as prod regex and that the retention override is time-limited (max 48h) for the canary. Also require an AR (access review) for the key ARN used.

sam: Good call. I'll set retention_grace_period_override=48h and attach `audit_mode_v2_ttl=48h` in the flag meta.

devops-bot: @sam preflight checklist: kube-deploy ready? image: inference-runtime:v3.2.1, configmap updated, rollout window set 02:00-04:00 UTC. Deploy job queued.

jonathan: I'll run the KMS/HSM walkthrough: confirm key ARNs, HSM proxy health, and behavior when HSM returns 429 vs 5xx. We should have explicit fallback logs for 429 only and throttle on 5xx.

security-bot: Reminder: record the runbook action id. Tag with `compliance:canary-auditv2` and capture logs to s3://redwood-audit-canary/1759004321/

maya: Also add a quick e2e test in the canary that simulates expired KMS token to exercise fallback and retention enforcement. Keep it small.

sam: I'll push a tiny smoke test and a Feature PR: patch + smoke test + runbook update. @jonathan can you review the runbook snippet?

jonathan: Yep. Ping me when PR is up. I'll review within the hour.

alice: If everything looks good, we should limit canary to org-internal only (no external customer data) until security signs off.

sam: Agreed — internal-alpha only. No external traffic.

ops: One more operational guard: if error rate on staging inference > 0.5% for 5m after rollout, auto-disable flag and alert on-call with pager duty.

maya: Perfect. Can you include the `ffctl` rollback hook? e.g.
```
ffctl rollback audit_mode_v2 --env staging --reason "auto-disable:error_rate"
```

sam: Will add that. Timeline: will open PR now, aim to merge and roll at 02:10 UTC if approvals done. Jonathan + Alice + Maya ack?

jonathan: ACK, I'll watch.

alice: ACK, compliance on standby.

maya: ACK :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Deploy started at 1759004520. Canary set to 10% internal. Monitoring hooks enabled.

sam: Thanks everyone. Will post back with results and any fallback logs (s3 link). If anything noisy, rollback immediately and notify channel.

security-bot: Canary runbook ID recorded: cbr-20260317-1759004321. Logs will persist for 30d under the compliance retention policy for canaries.

sam: Closing loop — smoke passed, no HSM fallbacks seen, retention override respected. Leaving flag at 10% for 24h then reassess. Will open separate thread for prod rollout when we have metrics.

maya: Awesome, thanks for the coordinated preflight.
